Home.title: African expertise. One trusted force.
Home.metadataDescription: Umoja assembles vetted African specialists into accountable teams for digital delivery and shared capability building.
Home.introduction: Umoja assembles vetted specialists into accountable teams to design, build, and operate digital products across a bilingual African network.

trust.title: One accountable team, assembled around the work.
trust.description: Umoja is a curated delivery collective, not an anonymous freelancer directory. Each project is shaped before staffing, then delivered through clear roles, interfaces, and shared responsibility.

operating.title: From a real need to a stronger shared capability.
operating.description: The operating model keeps client outcomes, contributor growth, and useful documentation connected throughout delivery.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Understand the need, context, constraints, and evidence required for a responsible project decision.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Shape the work into clear modules and bring together the right product, engineering, design, and growth expertise.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: Work as one accountable team with explicit interfaces, acceptance criteria, and documentation.

steps.title: Grow
steps.description: Turn delivery into learning, reusable knowledge, contributor progression, and stronger collective capability.

capabilities.title: Disciplines connected around the product, not sold in isolation.
capabilities.description: Umoja brings together the capabilities needed to move from discovery through dependable operation.

items.title: Product engineering
items.description: Product strategy, software architecture, web and application delivery, and long-term product stewardship.

items.title: Data and AI
items.description: Responsible data products, applied analysis, research, and automation grounded in a clear use case.

items.title: Enterprise modernization
items.description: Practical renewal of systems, workflows, and internal tools without losing essential operational context.

items.title: Cloud and operations
items.description: Reliable platforms, delivery infrastructure, observability, and operational practices built for continuity.

items.title: Design and brand
items.description: Research, service and product design, accessible interfaces, and coherent brand systems.

items.title: Digital growth
items.description: Useful content, audience strategy, experimentation, and sustainable paths from attention to adoption.

work.title: Evidence deserves consent and context.
work.description: Case studies will explain the challenge, Umoja’s contribution, the verified result, current status, and lessons—only after client and contributor approval.
work.emptyTitle: No unverified project will stand in for proof.
work.emptyDescription: The selected-work collection remains intentionally empty while historical records, outcomes, and publication permissions are reviewed.

network.title: Different roles, one connected institution.
network.description: Umoja links trusted delivery, a wider contributor network, learning and research, and independent organizations that originate meaningful work.
network.caption: Project access remains scoped to active roles and the least context needed for responsible delivery.

parts.name: Umoja Core
parts.description: Vetted contributors with broad delivery responsibility who can lead, review, mentor, and document.

parts.name: Umoja Extended
parts.description: Candidates and specialists contributing through clearly assigned modules and interfaces.

parts.name: AfricIT
parts.description: Learning, workshops, research, and public knowledge that strengthen practical capability.

parts.name: Partner organizations
parts.description: Verified independent organizations that bring work to a reusable shared workforce.

talent.title: Professional visibility, always by choice.
talent.description: Public profiles can show a chosen professional name, region, skills, seniority, and availability. Contact details and private employment information stay private.
talent.emptyTitle: Profiles will appear after opt-in review.
talent.emptyDescription: Umoja will not create fictional specialists or expose contributor data to fill this space.

africit.title: Delivery should leave more capability behind.
africit.description: AfricIT connects practical learning, public resources, and research themes to the needs revealed through real projects and African technology markets.

manifesto.title: Build in Africa. Grow with the work.
manifesto.description: We believe meaningful digital delivery can strengthen people, organizations, and shared institutions at the same time. Umoja is being built so trusted work creates experience, experience becomes knowledge, and knowledge opens a clearer path for the next contributor.

final.title: Bring the work. Bring your expertise.
final.buildDescription: Tell us what your organization needs to design, build, or operate. We’ll begin with context and feasibility.
final.growDescription: Join a consent-led path toward meaningful projects, learning, mentorship, and trusted contribution.
